name: M'ONDUNIQ Dermoaktiv skin-balancing serum with niacinamide
shortDescription: Professional, concentrated niacinamide face serum for the care of problem skin prone to oiliness and breakouts. 5 × 3 ml ampoules.
description:
The M'ONDUNIQ Dermoaktiv serum is a professional product developed specifically for the needs of problem skin, skin with enlarged pores, and skin prone to adolescent and adult acne.

Built on the innovative MONDOCEUTICALS technology, the formula uses targeted active ingredients to support the restoration of the skin's balance, helping regulate sebum production and reduce the visibility of blemishes.

The serum's key active ingredient is niacinamide (vitamin B3), which helps normalise sebaceous gland function, refine skin texture and reduce the visibility of enlarged pores. Thanks to its gentle hydrating effect, the skin can become smoother, more even-toned and more cared-for in appearance.

Application

Apply the serum to cleansed, dry skin of the face, neck and décolleté. It can be used on its own or combined with the creams and masks of the product family. Suitable for oxygen infusion cosmetic treatments and as a complement to manual facial massage. No rinsing required.

faq.question: How should the serum be used?

faq.answer: Suitable for oxygen infusion cosmetic treatments and as a complement to manual facial massage. It can also be integrated into professional cosmetic treatments.

faq.answer: For oily, combination, problem skin, skin with enlarged pores, and skin prone to adolescent and adult acne.

faq.answer: Niacinamide (vitamin B3): an active ingredient known for its sebum-regulating and skin-balancing properties, which contributes to a more even complexion and reduces the visibility of pores.
